purpose: Audio manager integration smoke test; these are not before/after performance claims.
text: 今日はいい天気ですね。少し休みましょう。
limitations: Only 3-10 second PCM16 WAV references with Japanese transcripts.
Removed and replaced library copies are retained so active replies can finish.
LLM protocol was validated with local HTTP mocks; no paid model call was made.

verification.portrait_test_note: The original baseline also intermittently failed fixed 230ms waits before the 200ms Qt animation completed. Tests now wait for transition completion and retain exact expression/pixel assertions; product animation is unchanged.

review.correctness: Checked rename/replace between streamed parts, next-turn changes, empty/disabled/missing references, failed atomic saves, preview cancellation and recovery.
review.readability: Kept reference persistence and Qt actions in separate focused modules; Designer layout is a new UI resource.
review.architecture: Traced desktop worker, LLM snapshot/schema/parser, turn-lock pipeline, TTS payload, playback lease and global configuration callers.
review.security: Validated WAV size/duration/format, bounded import/configuration sizes, unique names and UUID resource IDs; rejected export path traversal and duplicate response keys.
review.performance: Kept bounded streaming queues and existing sampling settings; deferred construction of audio widgets until first opening the tab.
